summary: Sega's stock-car arcade-racing series, tracked by original arcade entries, home revisions, and later official HD/embedded preservation routes.

entries.title: Daytona USA
entries.definitive_edition: 2011 HD digital release plus Saturn-mode supplement

emulation.emulator: Xbox backward compatibility / Sega Model 2 preservation route
emulation.notes: Use the owned Xbox digital license for HD play; otherwise the arcade cabinet remains the preservation baseline.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: HD console output with backward compatibility

primary.why: The 2011 console release preserves the arcade Daytona USA with HD presentation, online multiplayer, challenge and karaoke modes, both original and arranged soundtracks, and Xbox backward compatibility for newer Xbox consoles if already owned. It is the highest-fidelity practical home route; Saturn remains secondary only for its exclusive Saturn-mode content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 digital version on Xbox 360, Xbox One, or Xbox Series hardware if already purchased; if not owned, use an original arcade cabinet or other legitimate preserved route.

secondary.exclusive_content: Saturn mode, extra cars, Endurance mode, and Grand Prix mode with pit stops
secondary.what_to_play: Sample Saturn mode plus Endurance/Grand Prix after the HD main route.
secondary.why: These modes are unique to the Saturn-style home conversion, but the presentation is lower fidelity than the 2011 HD release.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Sega Model 2 cabinet and the authentic baseline.
all_releases.reason: skip: authentic original, but the 2011 HD release is the higher-fidelity home route and adds modern modes.

all_releases.fidelity: Lower-resolution home conversion with exclusive Saturn mode and endurance/grand-prix modes.
all_releases.reason: secondary: exclusive modes and extra cars, but lower visual fidelity than the HD release.

all_releases.fidelity: Windows port derived from the Saturn conversion.
all_releases.reason: skip: inherited the Saturn port's graphical compromises without a completeness advantage over Saturn plus HD.

all_releases.fidelity: HD digital release with the same core upgrade set.
all_releases.reason: skip: comparable HD route, but Xbox 360 is preferred for later Xbox backward compatibility if already owned.

all_releases.fidelity: HD digital release with online multiplayer, challenge/karaoke modes, soundtrack options, and later Xbox backward compatibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity/practicality combination for the arcade game, with Saturn kept only for exclusive modes.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The 2011 HD release is the fidelity route; the Saturn version has exclusive home modes and cars, so it is a secondary supplement.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Xbox 360 release was delisted in 2023, so it is a best-version recommendation for existing owners rather than a normal purchase route.

entries.title: Daytona USA: Championship Circuit Edition

emulation.notes: Use a compatibility wrapper or VM as needed for the 1997 Windows release.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC output of Daytona USA Deluxe

primary.why: Championship Circuit Edition is a reworked Saturn-era Daytona with new cars and courses. The Windows release, sold as Daytona USA Deluxe in most regions, adds the Silver Ocean Causeway course and network multiplayer, making it the most complete and highest-fidelity route for this revision.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Daytona USA Deluxe release on period PC hardware or a compatible modern Windows setup/VM; keep the Saturn version only for historical comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Championship Circuit Edition/Circuit Edition release with improved Saturn performance and two new courses.
all_releases.reason: skip: important original release, but Windows adds an extra course and network multiplayer.
skip: notable online-capable Saturn variant, but no sourced content advantage over the more complete Windows release.

all_releases.fidelity: PC Daytona USA Deluxe release with the added Silver Ocean Causeway course and network multiplayer.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete release of the Championship Circuit Edition branch.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is both the completeness route and the higher-fidelity home route for this branch.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a revised/remade Daytona branch with different handling and content, not a pure replacement for the 1994 arcade game.

entries.title: Sega Racing Classic

emulation.emulator: Original arcade hardware / RingWide preservation setup
emulation.notes: Cabinet hardware is the intended route.

primary.why: Sega Racing Classic is an enhanced arcade remake of Daytona USA released without the Daytona branding, using Sega RingWide hardware, HD graphics, and an arranged instrumental soundtrack. It is its own arcade-preservation route, not the most complete Daytona USA package.
primary.how_to_play: Play an original Sega Racing Classic arcade cabinet; for the broader original game package, use Daytona USA 2011 if owned.

all_releases.fidelity: Sega RingWide arcade remake with HD graphics and arranged instrumental soundtrack.
all_releases.reason: primary: only standalone release of this renamed arcade remake.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: It has HD arcade presentation but is not the most complete home package for the original Daytona USA.

entries.remaster_caveats: Released without Daytona branding because of licensing; treat it as a related remake rather than a direct replacement for Daytona USA 2011.

entries.title: Daytona USA 2: Battle on the Edge / Sega Racing Classic 2
entries.definitive_edition: Sega Racing Classic 2 inside Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii

emulation.emulator: Native PC host game / original Sega Model 3 hardware
emulation.notes: Use the official embedded release for home play; use cabinet hardware for original controls.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Modern PC output of the official embedded release

primary.version: Sega Racing Classic 2 inside Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii
primary.why: The original arcade Daytona USA 2: Battle on the Edge was arcade-only for decades. In 2025, the original edition was officially included as Sega Racing Classic 2 inside Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii, making the Windows version of that host game the highest-fidelity practical home route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the in-game arcade version inside Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii on Windows; use the original Model 3 arcade cabinet for cabinet authenticity.

all_releases.reason: skip: authentic cabinet route, but the 2025 official in-game release provides a modern home route.

all_releases.platform: Windows / PlayStation 4 / PlayStation 5 / Xbox One / Xbox Series X/S (inside Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii)
all_releases.fidelity: Official in-game arcade release of the original edition as Sega Racing Classic 2.
all_releases.reason: primary: official modern home route; Windows is the preferred platform for fidelity settings.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The modern embedded release covers the original edition; the arcade cabinet remains authentic but not more complete.

entries.remaster_caveats: The home route is embedded inside another game and renamed for licensing reasons.

entries.title: Daytona USA 2: Power Edition / Sega Racing Classic 2
entries.definitive_edition: Sega Racing Classic 2 inside Like a Dragon Gaiden

emulation.emulator: Native PC host game / original Sega Model 3 hardware
emulation.notes: Use the official embedded release for home play; use cabinet hardware for original controls.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Modern PC output of the official embedded release

primary.version: Sega Racing Classic 2 inside Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name
primary.why: Power Edition revised Daytona USA 2 with track and handling changes and was later officially included as Sega Racing Classic 2 inside Like a Dragon Gaiden. The Windows host version is the practical high-fidelity route for this revision.
primary.how_to_play: Play the in-game arcade version inside Like a Dragon Gaiden on Windows; preserve the arcade cabinet separately for the original cabinet experience.

all_releases.reason: skip: authentic cabinet route, but the 2023 official embedded release is the practical home route.

all_releases.platform: Windows / PlayStation 4 / PlayStation 5 / Xbox One / Xbox Series X/S (inside Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name)
all_releases.fidelity: Official in-game release of Power Edition as Sega Racing Classic 2.
all_releases.reason: primary: official modern home route; Windows is preferred for fidelity settings.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The modern embedded release covers the Power Edition revision; the arcade cabinet remains authentic but not more complete.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is the Power Edition revision, not the original Battle on the Edge version; keep both entries separate.

entries.title: Daytona USA 2001

emulation.notes: Use VGA-compatible output or high-resolution Dreamcast emulation.

primary.why: Daytona USA 2001 is a Dreamcast-only revamp that combines courses from Daytona USA and Championship Circuit Edition with three new tracks, upgraded graphics, split-screen play, and online features in some regions. Dreamcast is the only complete route for this entry.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Dreamcast disc on original hardware with VGA output or via a Dreamcast emulator such as Flycast/Redream; use restored fan servers only where supported and legal.

all_releases.fidelity: Only release, with upgraded Dreamcast graphics and a larger course set.
all_releases.reason: primary: sole platform and complete version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Dreamcast release is the only version.

entries.remaster_caveats: PAL online features were removed, and the original online service is no longer official; private-server restoration is a preservation route.

entries.title: Daytona Championship USA
entries.definitive_edition: Daytona Championship USA: New Season Edition if available

primary.version: Daytona Championship USA: New Season Edition if available
primary.why: Daytona Championship USA returned the Daytona-branded line to arcades, and New Season Edition is its update. The newest arcade cabinet/update is the only complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play a Daytona Championship USA cabinet, preferably updated to New Season Edition where available.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern Daytona arcade cabinet, with New Season Edition listed as the update.
all_releases.reason: primary: only platform and newest arcade update route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only an arcade release/update route is sourced.
